name: auto_generate
description: Generates a list of potential skill ideas (name, description, triggers, parameters) based on a given topic and desired count, assisting in the rapid development of new AI capabilities.

topic.description: The subject or domain for which to generate skill ideas (e.g., 'finance', 'health', 'productivity').

count.description: The number of skill ideas to generate (default: 5).

author: Project Ultron Autonomous Self-Evolution Engine
